verdict.rationale: BILL claims 'AI-powered spend management' that automatically categorizes and keeps transactions compliant, and separately touts an 'Invoice Coding Agent' for AI bill coding, showing some AI-driven categorization capability. However, there is no evidence of receipt OCR/reading, AI-generated memos, or explicit duplicate/fraud detection specifically within the Spend & Expense product. Missing for 10: receipt scanning/OCR evidence, memo-suggestion feature, duplicate/fraud detection capability, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of these AI behaviors.
